gate_changes_reviewed.change: Homeostasis completed its valid static terminal and fresh Evidence Analyst closure at HOLD with no same-object dynamic continuation
Receptor simultaneity produced a real positive synthetic signal that was fully reduced to stable tie ordering plus sequential adaptive gain and admitted only to one static Architecture contract study
Receptor static characterization prospectively separated public API permissiveness from supported/canonical workload reachability and withheld a dynamic comparator when reachability was unestablished

false_positive_risks: A synthetic or DEV-only positive could be laundered into supported-path prevalence, mechanistic distinctness, or novelty if supported reachability is not kept separate from public API permissiveness
An API-contract ambiguity could trigger a comparator before intended semantics and relevant workload are prospectively bound
A future extractor could still produce a wrong machine fact if fact-type-appropriate validation is not actually followed
false_negative_risks: Requiring demonstrated canonical workload prevalence for every public-boundary Architecture question would wrongly erase legitimate API/reproducibility ambiguities
Fail-closed handling would become overconservative if one disputed fact automatically rejected a candidate rather than only blocking dependent continuation
Global replication or support-threshold inflation would suppress useful Architecture/testbed work without addressing a demonstrated current failure mode

notes: exact provenance binding validates identity and inputs
machine-fact extractor validation checks whether recorded fields represent bound source/runtime semantics
supported-reachability characterization constrains prevalence and comparator allocation
artifact-to-handoff binding checks transfer into durable control-plane state
fresh Analyst review governs interpretation and successor allocation

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: Receptor source scope, machine-fact validity method, raw-before-interpretation order, terminal map and STOP were fixed before terminal interpretation; Homeostasis was closed without same-object rescue; no historical consumed result was repaired or relabeled.

required_path: claim-local adequate support and supported reachability where relevant
matched equal-privilege comparator where required by claim type
survive ordinary implementation and dynamical reductions
pass_reachability_assessment.current_limit: No active PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL object; current lower-funnel work remains Architecture/API characterization rather than a mechanism candidate.

external_calibration.use_rule: External literature and audit calibrate ordinary reductions, comparator scope, supported semantics and claim boundaries; they do not override machine artifacts or rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: The receptor case shows that withholding a low-information dynamic comparator when supported reachability is unestablished preserves rigor without deleting the unresolved API question. Additional global scientific strictness would now have low expected information gain and would suppress useful lower-funnel characterization.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the current scientific admission, novelty, reduction, comparator and FORMAL bars unchanged.

Preserve an explicit distinction between public API permissiveness and supported/canonical workload reachability: the former can justify an Architecture/API question; the latter is required for prevalence or stronger resource-allocation claims.
Keep positive synthetic diagnostics NON_EVIDENTIARY until an independently bound Architecture question is admitted; never relabel the Discovery output itself as Architecture evidence.
When supported reachability is unestablished, prefer HOLD plus bounded static contract characterization over either automatic REJECT or a manufactured dynamic comparator.
Continue fact-type-appropriate machine-fact validation, machine-bound handoff fidelity, and fresh Analyst STOP after every Architecture cycle.
Keep historical Suppression/Refractory/Temporal/Top-k outcomes unchanged and use them only as calibration examples.
Do not add programme-wide support or replication thresholds based on local Architecture outcomes.
questions_for_control_brain: Will public API permissiveness continue to preserve Architecture/API research worthiness without being treated as evidence of supported-path prevalence?
Will stronger dynamic comparator allocation continue to require explicit supported reachability or a genuinely fresh supported requirement?
questions_for_evidence_analyst: At fresh review, will receptor ordering remain HOLD at the mapped terminal unless independent evidence establishes supported same-key reachability or an explicit simultaneity contract?
Will future Architecture reviews continue to keep lack of canonical prevalence distinct from lack of API-contract research value?
